home.hero.title: SAC CO DO
home.hero.description: Explore Ninh Binh through an inspiring journey of culture, heritage, and traditional craft.
home.timeline.title: A journey light enough to play, deep enough to remember
home.timeline.description: Sac Co Do is more than a passport booklet. It connects paper craft, digital check-ins, and place-based discovery.
home.timeline.nibiAdvice: Follow the 3-step route below to connect with Ninh Binh heritage and unlock memorable rewards.
home.timeline.step1.title: Own your Passport
home.timeline.step1.description: Receive a premium handcrafted pop-up heritage passport with a personal ID code for your digital account.
home.timeline.step2.title: Check in along the route
home.timeline.step2.description: Explore 6 heritage stops and scan QR codes at experience stations to record your digital stamps automatically.
home.timeline.step3.title: Stamp & unlock AR
home.timeline.step3.description: Stamp your booklet, take photos with the Nibi AR mascot, and collect a keepsake reward.
home.locations.title: Explore 6 cultural destinations in Ninh Binh
home.locations.description: Each destination carries a historical story, a passport stamp, and its own immersive check-in experience.
home.products.title: Gifts that travel with the journey
home.products.description: Discover pop-up heritage notebooks and local souvenir gifts shaped by the identity of the ancient capital.
home.passport.lead: From a personal edition to companion combos and gift boxes.
home.passport.option1.title: Standard single passport
home.passport.option1.description: One pop-up passport for solo travelers or first-time experience buyers.
home.passport.option2.title: Companion combo
home.passport.option2.description: Two passports for couples, friend groups, or small families traveling together.
home.passport.option3.title: Sac Co Do gift box
home.passport.option3.description: A boxed edition for tourists, partners, or loved ones.
home.about.question: Can a trip leave more behind than just photographs?
home.about.paragraph: Sac Co Do was created from that simple question to build profound journeys in the ancient capital. Ninh Binh is a land where nature, history, and culture converge to create very distinct impressions. From the Trang An Landscape Complex, Hoa Lu Ancient Capital, Tam Coc – Dong to traditional craft villages and local specialties, each destination holds stories worth exploring and remembering.
home.about.nature.title: Majestic Nature
home.about.nature.desc: Trang An, Tam Coc, Hang Múa - where picturesque karst landscapes merge with the sky.
home.about.history.title: Rich History
home.about.history.desc: Ancient Hoa Lu capital, preserving the golden age of historic dynasties.
home.about.culture.title: Local Culture
home.about.culture.desc: Time-honored traditional craft villages and unique culinary specialties.
